answer.original_source: NN, Inc. announcement of late June 2026 liquid cooling expansion, relayed by finance.yahoo.com on 2026-07-01 (no independent origin identified for the claim beyond the company's announcement)
answer.new_information: Reported on 2026-07-01 by finance.yahoo.com: NN, Inc. announced in late June 2026 a liquid cooling production expansion for NVIDIA AI data center racks, adding 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant. The company said 100% of the new capacity was already pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards (customers not named). It targeted US$80-US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026 (party target, not a result). Same article also reports NN's removal from the Russell Microcap Value Index in late June 2026, a third-party narrative projection of NN revenue of $485.5M and earnings of $47.9M by 2028, and unnamed-analyst estimates of about US$489.5M revenue and US$48.3M earnings by 2028 (rumour tier). Remaining article text is promotional and unrelated to NVIDIA.
answer.reason: Covered company scope is NVDA only; NN is not a covered company. The claim is a supplier-side capacity and award fact with NVIDIA named only as the end use. No NVDA purchase order, revenue, backlog or supply commitment is stated, and the pre-sold awards come from unnamed customers, so nothing here establishes NVDA orders or revenue. Background-only use: a lead to watch for whether NN or NVIDIA later identifies NVIDIA as a customer or discloses a contract value for NVIDIA rack liquid cooling. Propose_new is not supported because no NVDA annual quantity, milestone, policy stage or obligation is established by this record. No catalog questions or stored pieces exist to update.
answer.independent_judgement: The incoming record is about NN, Inc., a supplier of liquid cooling capacity for NVIDIA-branded AI racks. Its 47 machine centers and 100% pre-sold status describe NN's own capacity and unnamed customer awards, not NVIDIA's revenue, backlog or purchase commitments. The NVIDIA link is an end-use description only. Any effect on NVDA would need NVIDIA or NN to identify the contract, volume or timing. The NN target of US$80-US$90 million is a party target for NN's new business, not an NVDA figure. The Russell index removal, the narrative projections and the unnamed-analyst estimates concern NN's trading and forecasts and do not bear on NVDA. Independent sources is true as the first identified origin (the NN announcement); no matched claim exists to corroborate.
